sn35.139:1.1: Yam bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ tam pajahatha || taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || || Kiñca bhikkhave na tumhākam || || Rūpā bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ te pajahatha || te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti || || Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || Dhammā na tumhākaṃ te pajahatha || || te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti || || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yam imasmiṃ Jetavane tiṇakaṭṭhaṃ || la || Evam eva kho bhikkhave rūpā na tumhākaṃ te pajahatha || te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti || || Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā
